mapper.sql: select cc.content_id, cc.course_id, cc.parent_id, cc.content_title, cc.content_type, cc.source_type, cc.file_name, cc.file_url, cc.cover_image, cc.link_url, cc.summary, cc.content_body, cc.duration_seconds, cc.exam_id, cc.is_preview, cc.sort_order, cc.publish_status, cc.view_count, cc.create_by, cc.create_time, cc.update_by, cc.update_time, cc.remark, c.course_name, e.exam_name from edu_course_content cc left join edu_course c on cc.course_id = c.course_id left join edu_exam e on cc.exam_id = e.exam_id
